items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: One occasion, I remember two of the bass horn players, tuba players, Wilbert Tillman was one of them

ctx.x: Of course, they had a clarinet in there, and he liked that clarinet player, I guess.

I remember now that you were talking about multiple bands that there were a couple of occasions when, for Sunday school parades, when they got to the Booker T. Washington Auditorium and the marches in the parade had to walk up these long steps to get into the big double doors, that the first band in the parade would pull off and stand at the foot of the steps and play, and as the other bands caught up, they would have this masked band effect, and by the time the whole parade was in, there'd be, on one occasion,…
